set.overview: A long slab and corner climb on Green Giant Buttress, just right of Dreamer. It begins at Dreamer's start and meets it again at the third belay, then goes straight up a big corner system toward the large roof while Dreamer wanders off to the left. Parties can rappel from the top of the corners or carry on to join Dreamer for the ridge. It runs a touch easier than its neighbor and is less runout, with bolts on the slabs and natural gear in the corners.
